dickinson-complete-poems.evidence: djvu title page and copyright page read; collection internetarchivebooks
dickinson-complete-poems.case: Bianchi's 1924 Complete Poems was the fullest pre-1931 edition. The PG Three Series is the clean-text fallback.
dickinson-complete-poems.note: Both are edited (regularised) texts, not the Johnson 1955 manuscript text (not PD). Nothing by Dickinson is held. Another 1924 scan: completepoemsofe00dick_1 (LoC), which has a garbled OCR front.
